title: Kaizen knowledge index item
description: One row in the knowledge SQLite index (~/.claude/.kaizen-knowledge/index.db). Produced by knowledge_index.py's iter_* generators and persisted via do_index. Consumed via do_search / do_get / knowledge_recent.

source.description: Which corpus this item came from.

source_path.description: Absolute path to the source file, or 'BK-N (path)' form for backlog items.

title.description: Human-readable title — typically the H1, the frontmatter name, or a derived label.

snippet.description: First ~400 chars of body, whitespace-normalised. Stored for display; embedded only when --embed-body.

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp from mtime or backlog updated_at; may be empty for derived items.

body_embedded.description: Was the snippet included in the embedding vector? Privacy-safe default: false (signature-only).

sha.description: Content-identity hash — 16-hex SHA1 prefix of (source|source_path|title|updated_at). Used for dedup + stale-removal.

id.description: SQLite primary key. Null on items emitted by iter_* before insert.

score.description: Cosine similarity score. Only present in do_search results.
